description: A NULL tariff short-circuits before the HTTP call. The detail queued with a NULL revision id is dropped at flush time, but the alert gate appends an equivalent row carrying a valid id, so the audit trail is COMPLETE. Pins the observable impact of the dropped-row defect at zero.

body.nt: ALERT: GROUND FAULT on phase A

sql.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM revision_details WHERE col='fault_note'
SELECT after_ FROM revision_details WHERE col='fault_note'
sql.value: ALERT: GROUND FAULT on phase A

sql.query: SELECT IFNULL(fault_note,'NULL') FROM charge_points WHERE id=1
SELECT alerted_at FROM charge_points WHERE id=1
